comments.headline: Complete required application and utility forms
comments.summary: Required fields in the main application and specialized forms are incomplete or missing, preventing full technical review. The primary site plan form, Austin Water utility documentation, erosion control plan, and professional seal require attention.
comments.crossDep: Austin Water and Environmental/Watershed departments for form completeness verification
comments.attn: Verify ESCP County field completion and Austin Water form section requirements with current template standards

details.text: Limits of Construction field in Section 8 (Site Area Information) of the site plan application is left blank with no value entered.

runComments.comment: Limits of Construction field in Section 8 (Site Area Information) is left blank with no value entered. This field is required to be completed as part of the net site area, limits of construction, proposed use, existing use, and existing zoning table on page 5.

details.text: All required application fields must be either completed with a value or explicitly marked 'N/A' if not applicable — leaving fields blank is not acceptable.

runComments.comment: Limits of Construction field is left blank rather than completed with a value or explicitly marked 'N/A'. All required fields must be either completed or clearly marked N/A.

details.text: Austin Water General Information and Construction Notes Sheet is missing required sections: AMOC (Alternative Method of Compliance) field with approval number and date, and a complete OWRS (Onsite Water Reuse System) Acknowledgment Form section per the current utility template.

runComments.comment: The Additional Review Acknowledgement section on the Austin Water General Information and Construction Notes Sheet is incomplete. The section is missing critical fields required by UCM 2.5.1.E.22: the AMOC (Alternative Method of Compliance) field with approval number and date, and a formal OWRS (Onsite Water Reuse System) Acknowledgment Form section. The current form shows only AULCC, ONSITE WATER REUSE & AW RECLAIMED INFORMATION questions, AUTOMATED METERING INFORMATION, and AULCC fields, but lacks the AMOC documentation field and complete OWRS acknowledgment fields that must be present in the current AW template.

details.text: ESCP (Erosion and Sedimentation Control Plan) County field on Sheet 5 could not be fully verified as completed. Confirmation that the County field in the Site Information table is properly filled is required.

runComments.comment: ESCP (Erosion and Sedimentation Control Plan) County field on Sheet 5 was not examined in detail. Verification that the TRAVIS county field is completed in the Site Information table is not verifiable from the available visual analysis.
